section.heading: Advanced Technical Centers Fund.

para.text: There is established as a special fund the Advanced Technical Centers Fund ("ATC Fund"), which shall be administered by OSSE in accordance with subsection (c) of this section.
There shall be deposited into the ATC Fund money paid to the District by private entities for the rental, use, or maintenance of space within an Advanced Technical Center facility.
Money in the ATC Fund shall be used to pay costs incurred by OSSE in operating and administering Advanced Technical Centers.

Any money remaining available in the ATC Fund at the end of a fiscal year, as determined by the Chief Financial Officer in the fiscal year-end close, shall be transferred to the unassigned fund balance of the General Fund of the District of Columbia as part of the fiscal year-end close.
For the purposes of this section, the term "Advanced Technical Center" shall have the same meaning as provided in § 38-2612.01(d)(1).
